title: Sensitive county expansion — review route before volume

counties.slate_anchor: the city walls and the siege of 1688–89
counties.sensitivity_summary: Contested siege memory; inside and outside the walls; public naming practice.

history.who_must_review: Independent local / period historian for multi-perspective 1688–89 treatment
history.what_must_be_reviewed: Attributed contemporary voices from more than one viewpoint; wall-as-map framing; contested date and naming precision

community.who_must_review: Cross-community local reader(s); NI terminology-aware editor
community.what_must_be_reviewed: Doire / Derry / Londonderry presentation; civilian experience; no single-community endorsement implied

rights.who_must_review: Rights owner / managing editor against source register
rights.what_must_be_reviewed: Edition and permission for every contemporary quotation or image before learner-facing use

language.who_must_review: Irish-language reviewer; Logainm / NI placename source check
language.what_must_be_reviewed: Place forms, invented pedagogical frames, no premature dialect claim

counties.slate_anchor: Aodh (Hugh) Ó Néill at Rathmullan; 1607 Flight of the Earls
counties.sensitivity_summary: Flight of the Earls and plantation aftermath; Ulster political memory; no generic witness headline.

history.what_must_be_reviewed: Short contemporary account or annal plus place-based departure source; sequential link to Tyrone without duplication

community.who_must_review: Donegal / Ulster community or local-history reader
community.what_must_be_reviewed: Departure framing, grief/leave language, avoidance of triumphalist or single-nation reading

rights.what_must_be_reviewed: Annal/edition quotation rights; Personal Atlas historical-name lines remain non-attestations

language.what_must_be_reviewed: Standard provisional frames vs any future Ulster-register claim; Rathmullan / person forms

counties.slate_anchor: Brian na Múrtha O'Rourke; sixteenth century
counties.sensitivity_summary: Gaelic polity under Tudor pressure; London trial and execution; conquest-narrative risk.

history.what_must_be_reviewed: Paired contemporary state record and Irish source; no simple conquest narrative

community.what_must_be_reviewed: Chief, land, law, and lose framing without humiliation spectacle

rights.what_must_be_reviewed: State-paper and Irish-source edition permissions before quotation

language.what_must_be_reviewed: Person and place forms; no invented trial speech presented as attestation

counties.slate_anchor: Patrick Sarsfield and the Treaty of Limerick; 1691
counties.sensitivity_summary: Contested treaty memory; promise versus aftermath; civilian-aware context required.

history.what_must_be_reviewed: Short treaty clause plus civilian-aware consequences; contested memory labelled

community.what_must_be_reviewed: Treaty, promise, peace language without triumphalism or erasure of aftermath

rights.what_must_be_reviewed: Treaty-text licence; no unsourced clause paraphrase as documentary fact

language.what_must_be_reviewed: Place forms; Munster-register claims only after named language source

counties.slate_anchor: Hugh O'Neill at Dungannon; late sixteenth century
counties.sensitivity_summary: Competing descriptions of one leader; must connect to Donegal flight without repeating departure scene.

history.what_must_be_reviewed: Annal or state-paper contrast; power at Dungannon before flight; no single-voice biography

community.what_must_be_reviewed: Leader framing, sequential Donegal link, avoidance of mythic heroisation

rights.what_must_be_reviewed: Edition rights for competing excerpts; historical-name pedagogy lines are not attestations

language.what_must_be_reviewed: Dungannon / person forms; historical_roleplay and source_ambiguity remain until review

counties.sensitivity_summary: Uprising, reprisal, and aftermath; multi-community civilian experience mandatory.

history.what_must_be_reviewed: Short balanced primary accounts from more than one community; complexity over puzzle/game framing

community.what_must_be_reviewed: Meeting, fear, choose, remember language; civilian aftermath; no endorsement claimed

rights.what_must_be_reviewed: Permissions for 1798 sources and any adaptation before quotation

language.what_must_be_reviewed: Invented pedagogical frames; no invented rebel speech as attestation
